LanguageData.RT_Make_BMP3_Blueprint.description:
Assembly of BMP-3 IFV at the Assembly gantry.
<color=#b0e0e6>Required craftable ammunition (Ammo crafting table):</color> - 100mm 2A70 Cannon: 3UOF19 (HE), 9M117M (HEAT) [ATGM] - 30mm 2A72 Autocannon: 30x173mm cartridge (FMJ / HE / AP-I) - 7.62mm PKT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP) - (Upgrade 2S38 Turret): 57x348mmSR (AP / AP-HE / Sabot)
